diagnoses.bug: The simulator dispatches only once per tick, so when a zero-duration start finishes inline, it does not dispatch the next waiting customer at that same tick.
diagnoses.lesson: After processing an immediate completion, continue the same-tick state machine until no further event or dispatch is enabled.

diagnoses.bug: Preemption reconstructs spent patience from a waiter entry for the running customer, but that customer was removed at dispatch, so spent waiting is reset to zero and its full patience budget is restored.
diagnoses.lesson: Track cumulative resource consumption explicitly across state transitions; never infer historical totals from entries that are removed during transitions.

diagnoses.bug: The rounding test compares squared-distance remainder against the linear midpoint threshold, so edge lengths can round incorrectly.
diagnoses.lesson: For nearest-integer rounding of a square root, compare against the exact squared midpoint rather than a linear remainder threshold.

diagnoses.bug: rounded_sqrt_milli compares squared-distance errors, which does not round the square root to the nearest integer; it must compare against the exact midpoint between adjacent integers.
diagnoses.lesson: When rounding a square root, compare the radicand against the squared midpoint between neighboring integer results, accounting explicitly for ties.

diagnoses.bug: The edge-length rounding helper multiplies squared distance by 1,000,000 and then by 4, which can overflow u128 for full-range i64 coordinates and panic in debug builds.
diagnoses.lesson: Check intermediate arithmetic bounds across the full input type range; use wider or checked arithmetic where products can exceed the destination type.

diagnoses.bug: edge_mill can overflow u128 in its rounding comparison for the largest valid coordinate differences, producing an incorrect rounded length.
diagnoses.lesson: Bound intermediate arithmetic across the full input range; use wider or overflow-safe comparisons when scaling squared values.

diagnoses.bug: Percent-decoding errors in patterns are incorrectly returned as InvalidPath instead of InvalidPattern.
diagnoses.lesson: Keep error classification tied to the input context throughout shared parsing helpers; verify every failure path preserves the caller’s error type.

diagnoses.bug: Building a route with an empty wildcard adds its preceding slash, so `/assets/*tail` with an empty tail incorrectly builds as `/assets/` instead of `/assets`.
diagnoses.lesson: Handle empty variadic components explicitly when constructing paths; verify that omitted components do not leave unintended separators.

diagnoses.bug: The decoder accepts an incomplete three-digit group ending in `=` because it never records that position-three padding completed the group or emits its two decoded bytes.
diagnoses.lesson: Track parser state explicitly and finalize each accepted construct immediately; do not infer completion afterward from the input’s last byte.

diagnoses.bug: restore and forget check only for an empty name, so invalid nonempty names bypass the required NameInvalid validation.
diagnoses.lesson: Apply every specified validation rule to each relevant operation, preserving the required error precedence before lookup or mutation.

diagnoses.bug: The IPv6 suffix is validated before checking whether the host interior contains a closing bracket, but this code accepts the first closing bracket even when another bracket occurs later in the authority as component content.
diagnoses.lesson: When parsing delimited structures, validate the complete structure and its boundary before interpreting any suffix or trailing content.

diagnoses.bug: normalise_path slices the decoded string at byte index 1, which can panic when the first character after '/' is multibyte UTF-8.
diagnoses.lesson: When slicing UTF-8 strings, derive indices from valid character boundaries; test multibyte input at every boundary-sensitive operation.

diagnoses.bug: parse_query computes a value's base offset using field.contains('='), so a later '=' in the value is mistaken for the key/value delimiter and error offsets are shifted.
diagnoses.lesson: When reporting offsets after splitting input, carry the exact delimiter position forward instead of recomputing it from the whole field.

lessons: Check intermediate arithmetic across the full input range; use wider or overflow-safe comparisons when products can exceed the destination type.
Apply every specified validation rule to each relevant operation, preserving required error precedence before lookup or mutation.
Track cumulative resource consumption explicitly across state transitions; do not infer historical totals from entries removed during transitions.
Continue same-tick state processing after immediate completion until no event or dispatch remains enabled.
Compare a square-root radicand against the exact squared midpoint between neighboring integers, handling ties explicitly.
Track parser state explicitly, validate complete delimited structures and boundaries, and finalize each accepted construct immediately.
Preserve input context through shared parsing helpers so every failure path reports the required error classification.
Use valid character boundaries for UTF-8 slicing, and carry exact delimiter positions forward when reporting offsets after splitting.
